description: OutX: an output expander that taps the buffer of the module it is attached to, channel by channel, and can take those values out of it; it goes to the right of that module

params.text: Chooses whether the jacks take one channel each or a range at a time, marked Individual and Normalled
Chooses whether a tapped value is left in the buffer or taken out of it, marked Copy and Cut

outputs.text: Carries that channel of the buffer; with cut switched on, that value is removed from the buffer, or turned low if the buffer holds gates

notes: this module is placed to the right of the module it expands, or beside another connected output expander on that side
attached to Spike, a jack only goes high when the play head actually reaches that step
